lines.text: Did you know? Tend is Latin for stretch.
Quick quiz! Which means out plus stretch?

words.ex: The heat in the afternoon was intense.
To some extent, I agree with your opinion.

publish.title: Tend root: intense and extent
publish.value: Tend comes from Latin "tendere" (to stretch). Words: intense and extent. intense = in + tense; extent = ex + tent.
